confirmedUiFindings.title: Mobile toast overlaps the phone-app shortcut
confirmedUiFindings.expected: A notification should not cover an unrelated interactive control.
confirmedUiFindings.actual: Playwright physical-input evidence identifies a toast intercepting taps on #townDevice beyond the original five-second action timeout.
confirmedUiFindings.recommendation: Reposition the toast stack away from interactive map controls, or allow input through noninteractive notification content. Waiting for normal expiry is a harness accommodation, not a game fix.

confirmedGameplayFindings.title: Midgame diversification does not ensure different final career/qualification paths
confirmedGameplayFindings.expected: The requested midgame diversification should prevent all three rivals finishing a full-length game on the same job and completed qualifications when they can pursue alternatives.
confirmedGameplayFindings.actual: Full 30-day games ended with all three active rivals on the same job and completed qualifications despite avoidCareer/avoidTrack pivot preferences. Early game-over cases before the pivot window are excluded.
confirmedGameplayFindings.likelyCauses: Code review suggests rivalDay retains an existing r.study even after the target changes, requires positive pay gain for alternative jobs, and schedules work before allocating study time. In several expert snapshots study progress was zero and knowledge had decayed to zero. These are inferred contributing causes, not isolated causal tests.
confirmedGameplayFindings.recommendation: Add a targeted pivot regression case; reconcile active study with the new target, reserve study time in the work budget and assess feasible alternate jobs explicitly.
